bootstrap.scope: unadjusted descriptive input-block interval; zero-width zero interval is not equivalence

analysis.denominator: 20 distinct input blocks; all errors/timeouts retained; 60 method calls are not independent observations
analysis.external: evidence CHECKED_CONDITIONAL versus CROWN numerical positive filter, never a pooled formal-SAFE count
analysis.incomplete_run: retain unattempted roster, no completed-cohort conclusion
analysis.primary: evidence CHECKED_CONDITIONAL versus matched HZ-policy SAFE: paired complete-positive indicators, explicitly unequal evidence contracts
report: positive intersections and gained/lost input indices
common fact equality when both observable

protocol.evidence_scope: checks stored shared HZ projection, LP export, signed range bounds, rational McCormick construction, dual bounds, scoped reuse and all pair/property obligations; trusts network/input->HZ, ordered source bindings, guard lowering and route exclusions; not deployed floating-point proof
excluded_costs: later archival audit cannot rescue a request
protocol.failures: ERROR fail-stop with retained artifacts and remaining roster; TIMEOUT/UNKNOWN continue; no resume, retry, sample substitution, range refinement or acceptance-gate change
protocol.gate_rule: checked router-order lower >=0 -> lambda lower 1/2; checked opposite lower >=0 -> lambda upper 1/2; otherwise 0 or1; tied zero -> [1/2,1/2]; no sigmoid refinement

method_changes.crown: unchanged ACT route frontend plus plain CROWN full-box variable-weight static pairs, CPU float64 conv_mode matrix
method_changes.evidence: same independently charged V2 common interval prelude; all residual pairs captured before proposals; rational pre-F0 LP; local check, packing, isolated check
method_changes.matched: unchanged matched monolithic configuration under V2

protocol.next_gate: this stage freezes only; no 60-request execution before clean freeze reconstruction, controls, publication and separate launch instruction
protocol.order: input blocks, cyclic rotations [matched,evidence,crown] by rank modulo3
protocol.property: all C-1 clean-class margins; general evidence API also accepts explicit linear properties
protocol.proposal_order: sorted pair then router lo/hi and sorted residual property difference lo/hi; then weighted objectives in pair/property order; no retry
protocol.reuse: property-specific checked exact finite-box bound from charged membership interval; both experts required; no historical facts
protocol.scope: separately frozen 20-input convolutional comparison; no effect-selected expansion
protocol.selection: ascending clean-correct test indices after frozen union of all earlier verification/development indices; no route counts, margins or bounds consulted; prior full-test telemetry disclosed
